name: Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers
benefit:
- Accidental Death: ₹5,00,000/-
- Permanent Disability: ₹5,00,000/-
- Natural Death Relief: ₹60,000/-
_eligibility_text:
***Eligibility for Accidental Death/Natural Death Relief*** 1. The applicant should be the nominee/dependent of the deceased construction worker. 1. The deceased construction worker should be registered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
***Eligibility for Permanent Disability*** 1. The construction worker should be registered under the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The construction worker should be disabled.
